title_zh: 央行：支持更多境外投资者投资中国市场
title_en: Central Bank: Supporting More Foreign Investors to Invest in China's Markets

paragraphs.zh: 10月16日，中国人民银行副行长陶玲在上海的一个财富管理论坛上表示，央行将支持更多类型的境外投资者在中国金融市场投资。他们可以买中国的股票、债券、黄金和期货等产品。
paragraphs.en: On October 16, Tao Ling, deputy governor of the People's Bank of China, said at a wealth management forum in Shanghai that the central bank will support more types of foreign investors in investing in China's financial markets. They can buy Chinese stocks, bonds, gold, futures and other products.

paragraphs.zh: 陶玲介绍，到2026年6月底，已经有1200家境外机构来到中国的银行间债券市场。境外投资者持有的中国债券大约有3.2万亿元，持有的中国股票大约有4.7万亿元。
paragraphs.en: Tao Ling said that by the end of June 2026, 1,200 foreign institutions had already entered China's interbank bond market. Foreign investors hold about 3.2 trillion yuan of Chinese bonds and about 4.7 trillion yuan of Chinese stocks.

paragraphs.zh: 她说，境外企业和机构拿到人民币以后，不仅要“愿意持有”，还要“能够长期持有”。所以，中国需要提供更多可以投资的人民币资产，也要提供管理风险的工具。
paragraphs.en: She said that after foreign companies and institutions get renminbi, they should not only be "willing to hold" it but also "able to hold it for the long term." So China needs to offer more renminbi assets to invest in, and also provide tools for managing risk.

paragraphs.zh: 这些措施的目的是让人民币在国际上用得更多。如果更多境外资金来到中国市场，中国的金融市场会更开放，人民币也会变得更国际化。
paragraphs.en: The aim of these measures is to make the renminbi used more widely around the world. If more foreign money comes into China's markets, China's financial markets will become more open, and the renminbi will become more international.

vocab.en: open (to the outside world); to open up

featured.note: 投资 + 对象 (投资股票 / 投资房地产 / 投资一家公司)；也可作名词 (外国投资、长期投资、一笔投资)；常见搭配：投资者、投资风险、吸引投资。

examples.zh: 很多境外投资者开始投资中国的债券。
examples.py: Hěn duō jìngwài tóuzīzhě kāishǐ tóuzī Zhōngguó de zhàiquàn.
examples.en: Many foreign investors have started investing in Chinese bonds.

examples.zh: 学习一门语言是对自己最好的投资。
examples.py: Xuéxí yì mén yǔyán shì duì zìjǐ zuì hǎo de tóuzī.
examples.en: Learning a language is the best investment in yourself.

examples.zh: 我哥哥用他的奖金投资了一家小咖啡店。
examples.py: Wǒ gēge yòng tā de jiǎngjīn tóuzī le yì jiā xiǎo kāfēidiàn.
examples.en: My older brother used his bonus to invest in a small coffee shop.

featured.note: 有风险 / 风险很大 / 降低风险 / 管理风险 / 风险管理 / 投资风险；“冒风险” = to take a risk.

examples.zh: 股市有风险，投资要小心。
examples.py: Gǔshì yǒu fēngxiǎn, tóuzī yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.en: The stock market carries risk, so invest carefully.

examples.zh: 银行需要降低贷款的风险。
examples.py: Yínháng xūyào jiàngdī dàikuǎn de fēngxiǎn.
examples.en: Banks need to reduce the risk of their loans.

examples.zh: 下雨天开车开得太快，风险太大了。
examples.py: Xià yǔ tiān kāi chē kāi de tài kuài, fēngxiǎn tài dà le.
examples.en: Driving too fast on a rainy day is far too risky.
